name: dm-minute-digits-compared-as-integer
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.10 rule 3 of the transforms: the minute digits 59 are below 60, so the text is accepted; the minutes text is read as its nearest double, 60.0; 60/60 + 48 = 49; encode m = round(49*60*10^4) = 29400000, 49 degrees 0 minutes, 4900.0000. Checksums by a standalone XOR.
